name: m2-goals-2026-10-27
status: BCRG working preferences, not confirmed Foundation criteria

how_to_read.expr: A pandas expression over the sweep's wide table. A name prefixed baseline__ reads the same column on the paired baseline run, joined on baseline_row_id and the horizon.
how_to_read.threshold: The pass line. op is one of >=, >, <=, < with a number in value, or 'between' with [low, high] in value.
how_to_read.utility.linear: 0 at floor, 1 at target, straight between them and clipped to 0 and 1. A floor above the target means lower is better.
how_to_read.utility.step: 1 when the metric passes its threshold, otherwise 0.
how_to_read.utility.band: 1 inside [low, high], falling straight to 0 at low_floor below and high_floor above.
how_to_read.goal.utility: The weighted mean of its metrics' utilities.
how_to_read.goal.pass_rule: all_metrics: the goal passes when every metric passes its threshold. utility_at_least: the goal passes when its utility reaches pass_utility.
how_to_read.combine: The combined utility is the weighted mean of the goal utilities. Weights are normalised, so they need not sum to 1.
how_to_read.regions: The highest-utility region holds the setting cells whose mean combined utility is within utility_tolerance of the best cell. The all-goal region holds the cells where at least pass_share of runs pass every goal. A cell needs min_runs_per_cell runs.
